title: fix(audit): a search the server widens never names a column the caller may not query
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96xkbCcbB1nF3xM9vBtrWwE)_

Fixes #34700

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or docs page teaches this search set.

Scope: item ① of the card, the server-side list search: the auditor's audit-log search no longer turns the list into 403. The card's other items have landed elsewhere: item ② in PR #34880 (merged `c41b6ca286`), the ui half in PR #35389 (via #34741). So `Fixes #34700` closes the card once this lands. Continued by seat repo:objectstack#4 from `12455d5acc` (claim 7121652462).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 服务端为列表搜索自动选出的字段集，不再包含对象自身查询守卫会对该调用者拒绝的列（审计日志的 `old_value` / `new_value` 快照列、活动流的值列），和 #25672 对「调用者不能查询的字段」的处理一致。调用者在 `searchFields` 里自己点名的列不扣，照旧由守卫拒绝。
- **为什么改：** 三员模式下审计员在审计日志列表里一输入搜索词，整页变成「无权访问」：服务端替他把守卫列放进了搜索集，守卫随即拒掉整个搜索。
- **风险与回滚：** 守卫本身不变，仍是唯一执行点；若扣得不够，守卫照样拒绝，失败方向是拒绝而不是多读。不动 spec。本轮与 main 合并后 `engine.ts` 超出门面行数上限，所以接口从引擎上的新方法改为 `registerMiddleware` 的选项 `withholdSearchFields`（守卫中间件在注册时自带），行为不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/parent-field-query-guard.ts` 的 `withheldSearchColumns` 与注册处；`packages/objectql/src/engine-find.ts` 的 `resolveSearchWithheldFields`；`packages/qa/dogfood/test/activity-text-predicate.dogfood.test.ts` 那条改过的钉。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-search-field-withholder.test.ts`，预期 11 条全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 确认一条既有安全 dogfood 钉的改动：活动流的自由搜索从「匹配与不匹配都拒（403）」改为「两者答得一样（200）；点名守卫列 `summary` 的搜索仍拒（403）」。该确认此前已请求、尚无记录。

## What changes

- `packages/objectql`: `registerMiddleware(fn, options)` takes `EngineMiddlewareOptions` (declared in `engine-top-level.ts`, exported from the package). Its new `withholdSearchFields` is a guard middleware's search-field withholder. Before a non-blank `search` is expanded, the withholders of the middlewares that run for the object (the same object selector `executeWithMiddleware` applies) name fields to leave out of the server-resolved set, beside the `getQueryableFields` answer (`search-filter.ts` `withheldFields`). A field the caller names in `searchFields` is kept. Context-less reads and blank terms ask nothing. A set left empty is the existing `400 INVALID_FIELD`. A throw propagates.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/parent-field-query-guard.ts`: the guard's verdict is one function (`guardRefuses`), shared by the middleware and its withholder (`withheldSearchColumns`), so the two answer the same rule. Each guard declares its withholder in the registration it already makes. An engine that does not read the option keeps the guard alone, as before.
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`: census row 45 owns `withheldSearchColumns`.

### Delta since the last reviewed head `54107ea2ac` (L1-c2 ACCEPT 6947307277)

1. `12455d5acc` (unreviewed until now): the dogfood pin in `activity-text-predicate.dogfood.test.ts` follows the rule. Before, on `main`: for a stored value and a non-matching value, `$search=VALUE` on `sys_activity` answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. After: `$search=VALUE` answers `200`, the matching and the non-matching probe give the same `{ status, rows }`, and `$search=VALUE&$searchFields=summary` answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. The merge leaves this pin as it is in `12455d5acc` (main did not touch the file).
2. `9fa0bb95b`, merge of `origin/main` `f46ce5b4a`: one conflict in `parent-field-query-guard.ts`. Main passes the caller to `parentFieldQueryRefusal` (its `userMessage`). It is resolved as the `guardRefuses` call with main's caller argument.
3. `6dcdf177c` + `18bafcac5`: after the merge, `engine.ts` was 6880 lines, above its facade ceiling of 6857 (`scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json`, ruling 7051956587; main sits at 6857). The seam moved off the facade: the withholder is now the middleware's own option, not the method `ObjectQL#registerSearchFieldWithholder`. The entry type lives in `engine-top-level.ts`. `engine.ts` ends at 6856 lines and the gate is green. Behaviour is unchanged. One pin is added: a withholder on a middleware for every object (no object, or `'*'`) is asked for each object.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-search-field-withholder.test.ts`: the seam's contract on `find` / `findOne` / `count`. It covers what is asked, a named field kept, nothing withheld, context-less and blank searches, another object's withholder not asked, an every-object withholder asked, an emptied set answering `400 INVALID_FIELD`, and a throw propagating.
- `plugin-audit` `audit-log-predicate-guard.test.ts` and `activity-predicate-guard.test.ts`: both objects, pinned and unpinned, plus `count`. A search naming a guarded column is still refused.
- dogfood `audit-log-audit-capability.dogfood.test.ts` (the HTTP door for the holder, the read-only member and the admin control) and `activity-text-predicate.dogfood.test.ts` (the pin in item 1 above).

## Acceptance notes

- The seam's shape changed after the L1 ACCEPT, which covered `54107ea2ac` only. This head needs its own review.
- Raising the `engine.ts` ceiling was the alternative to moving the seam. That needs a maintainer ruling, so it was not taken.

## Verification

All at head `18bafcac5`, after the merge, with the closure built (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`, exit 0).

<details><summary>Suites under the lock</summary>

- objectql full suite: 637 files / 14378 tests passed.
- objectql search set (`src/engine-search*`, `src/search-filter*`, `src/engine-middleware*`): 6 files / 70 tests.
- plugin-audit full suite: 109 files / 1827 tests.
- dogfood `activity-text-predicate` + `audit-log-audit-capability`: 2 files / 39 tests.
- Typecheck of objectql and plugin-audit (including `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 109 derived, 109 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, with an exit code recorded for each of the 109 and all of them 0. That includes `check:facade-delegation-only`, which was red before the seam moved. `check-nul-bytes` and `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` both exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation of the moved wiring</summary>

Mutation: the `withholdSearchFields` line in plugin-audit's guard registration was removed with `ablation-replace.mjs`. plugin-audit was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` confirmed the line was gone from dist. Result: 6 red in the plugin-audit search cases and 4 red in dogfood (the activity pin in three reader classes, plus the audit-log holder case). The named-column refusals stayed green.

Restore: the blob is back to the HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` is empty. plugin-audit was rebuilt and the preflight confirmed the marker is absent. Result: 76/76 and 39/39 green.

</details>

Full dogfood battery: not run. The title carries no `!` and `Clause-②` has no narrowing arm. CI's Dogfood Regression Gate is the reading of record.
